title: SDK starter kits: Next.js (TS), FastAPI, Go HTTP server, and CLI cookbook
creator: Priya Nair
description: Create a set of production-oriented SDK starter templates and cookbook snippets that demonstrate idiomatic usage of Redwood SDKs (Python, TypeScript, Go). Deliverables: a Next.js TypeScript starter app showing streaming chat with server-side edge route and client-side incremental rendering; a FastAPI + Uvicorn example demonstrating streaming token responses, structured output parsing, request retries with exponential backoff and jitter, and background KV cache integration; a minimal Go HTTP server example (net/http) showing server-side streaming, context cancellation, and efficient token handling for high-concurrency endpoints; a CLI tool (Python + Click and Go variants) illustrating embed->search->generate workflows, rate-limited batching, and CLI-friendly progress/streaming UX. The cookbook should include short, copy-paste snippets for: retry strategies (idempotency tokens, safe retry windows), streaming ergonomics (server-sent events vs chunked responses, client reconnection and resume), batching and backpressure suggestions, environment/config patterns (credential loading, region/endpoint fallbacks), and quick deploy steps for Vercel, Docker Compose, and simple systemd service for Go. Each example must include a README with usage, tests (integration smoke test or local e2e), recommended config for production (timeouts, max inflight requests), and a small CI job to run the smoke tests.
acceptance_criteria: Next.js starter demonstrates streaming chat and client incremental rendering with sample prompts and tests
FastAPI example shows streaming token endpoint, safe retry wrapper, and a sample KV cache usage with docs
Go HTTP server implements context-aware streaming, graceful shutdown, and a small benchmark script
CLI example(s) provide a common pattern for embed->search->generate and expose clear flags for retries, timeout, and streaming toggles
Cookbook contains 8-10 focused snippets (retry patterns, streaming resume, batching guides) with copy-paste examples
All examples include LICENSE, contributing notes, smoke tests, and CI job that runs locally in 2 minutes
Docs include recommended production configs: timeouts, max_concurrency, batch_size, cache_ttl, and auth rotation guidance
steps: Draft minimal API surface for examples and agree on SDK entrypoints (py client, ts client, go client)
Implement streaming helpers and retry wrappers in each language and publish as internal helpers in examples
Add README, usage examples, smoke tests, and CI job for each template
Run a small internal review with DX team and Solutions Eng to validate ergonomics and docs
Incorporate feedback, finalize copy, and tag release sdk-2026.03-examples
